game.name: Brave : A Warrior's Tale (USA)
game.desc: 70 years after the first Brave game on PS2, the Indian tells his first adventures to the younger generation. The remake Brave: A Warrior's Tale on Xbox 360 is thus experienced in the manner of a flashback. This action/adventure game has us follow the young Indian in his quest to find Dancing Spirit, the only warrior capable of helping him save his village. The animals will lend a hand to the hero by helping him with some special powers.
